proposals.old_text: You are a structured data extraction assistant. Extract the requested fields from the input text. Output each field on its own line as 'field: value'.
proposals.new_text: You are a structured data extraction assistant. Extract the requested fields from the input text. Output each field on its own line as 'field: value' (use exact field names, be concise, and include all required fields).
proposals.hypothesis: Adding explicit guidance on field naming consistency, conciseness, and completeness directly in the instruction line will reduce the three failure patterns by making expectations clearer.
proposals.expected_improvement: Reduction in inconsistent naming (pattern 1), verbosity (pattern 2), and missing fields (pattern 3) by at least 10% each, as measured by trace_id occurrences.
